Adam is a good lecturer. He is helful and organized. However, you need more outside materials and works to do well on quizzes and exams because they are significantly tough.
Okay lecturer, but much better than any of the other choices. I recommend going to office hours.

This guy right here cannot teach, he frequently confuses himself. I've never had a professor that told student not to ask questions because he's not ready to answer questions. I hope he gets fired because he's not qualify to teach .

Adam is super nice, but he's a pretty useless lecturer. He teaches straight out of the textbook and doesn't provide much guidance beyond it, which is good in that it's easy to follow the material but bad in that you don't get much else outside the book. He's very kind and caring though, so I enjoyed his class as much as you can enjoy a stats class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: This man right here is one of the most difficult professors that I have ever had here at Cal. He does not teach as well as Mike Leong. If you want to learn Stats, just take the adjunct course.

Absolutely could not stand bearing through his lectures. He is not engaging and often confused me even more. His explanations during lecture are not clear & he jumps all over the place. Youre better off going to his office hours, where he usually explains stuff a little bit better. Thought his tests & quizzes were tricky. Class was quite stressful
Great Professor. Really cares about students, and is an awesome person in general. Class is fine as long as you review lectures since it can get dense pretty quickly if you fall behind.
First class. He often asks us whether we understood and gives us chance to think by self and discuss. Clear speaking is another advantage over other professors.

Hardest Stats course EVER. Lecture and concepts are simple. Homework is pretty easy. However his exams were NOTHING like what he taught on the lecture and his notes. If the homeworks difficulty level is 1 then the exam level is 10 You gotta be very good at math to do well on the exams. Otherwise, like me, no matter how I worked hard still got a C.
Great lecturer and really cares about students! Easy to talk to if you ask questions after class or during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Lucas is great! There was (short) homework due for every class which I appreciated because it kept us on track. He always taught stuff directly related to hw. Tried to get us to use R through a site called data camp but it was tough logistically. Midterm was much harder than expected, but he curves everything at the end and plenty of prep.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: A very smart professor and cares a lot about students' success. However, an unclear teacher with high expectations thus many concepts were either left unexplained or became even more confusing. Expanded buckets because of the students' anxieties but that would've been unnecessary if he was a better teacher.
Very helpful and approachable.

He's a nice enough guy, but his lectures are unorganized and unclear. Tests seem like they would be easy based off of lectures and homework, but are extremely hard with very little help in preparation. There is no clear grading criteria and you could be at a disadvantage based off what gsi you have.

Such a sweet guy. His exams are much more difficult than you would expect based on how he talks in class, and he doesn't provide practice tests for midterms or finals. Overall if you study hard it is still possible to do well in the class but it is not straightforward at all.

To be honest the lecture material isn't that hard and you can have a good understanding of it but the questions on the exam are downright unfair. No matter how much you study or how many practice problems you do the questions are the exam are made to trick you. Also depending on your GSI you can have a unfair advantage during exams.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've ever taken in my life. Makes exams unnecessarily hard, so even if you do the reading and practice midterm you'll still not know how to answer the questions on his exam. Unorganized also, definitely do not take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Lucas is a super nice guy but is not the greatest professor. If you ask for help he will assist you, but assumes to much out of his students.

Really a great professor who wants the best for his students. As others have stated he teaches mainly upper divs so sometimes he doesn't have the clearest of explanations. GSI was meh at best which probably didn't help. Lucas is very approachable though so make use of OH if need be.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: This class was a  requirement for me and I'm glad that I chose Professor Lucas. His lectures are clear and easy to follow. Tests were difficult with some questions coming out of left field, but a decent amount of studying will help you pass. I also found it helpful to meet with the GSI's for extra help. Overall, great class for a stats class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's kind, but unorganized. Released incorrect solutions for homework and quizzes. Does not adhere to historical grade distribution of the class.

He's a really nice guy who genuinely wants the best for his students. But since he mainly teaches upper div theory classes, he's not good at explaining the basic concepts. Not the best teacher for an intro class. The extra credit is a lot of work- only worth it if you don't think you're going to do well. Section is definitely worth it.

Extra Credits are useless. They only make up 1% of the total grades :( Do your reading before the lectures, especially for the last 1/3 of the class. Take the advantage of the discussion sections. Both of the GSIs I go to are very helpful. Adam is actually a very generous professor in the Stats Dept. I would take his class again for 133 if possible

Prof Lucas is really sweet and quirky. He really wants everyone to do well. The class is a great pace, not too fast, and he explains material very well. The first midterm is very easy and the second (with probability) is more difficult. He gives extra credit hw and partial credit on tests. Beware, the curve is annoying and it's hard to get an A.

This class was pretty easy. But beware, the average is really high so it's hard to get an A. Lucas was a fine teacher. Taught us exactly what we should know and taught clearly--though he was a weird/awkward personality. He gave the GSIs a ton of examples in disc. iclicker questions in randomly for points in class. Overall, he was a good teacher.
Work hard, and it will pay off! Pay attention in class, and go to office hour. Lastly, pray to the curve god if you are taking a class as cutthroat as stats 21. Good luck!

Professor Lucas is such a sweet guy, but he is not as easy as others made him to be when I saw the reviews here in the summer. The main problem is that his problems sets were sometimes misleading- meaning that the ones you practiced the most are probably not on the midterms or the final. My suggestion is to go to not his, but his GSIs' OH!

Great professor. Ended up with an A, although the curve is pretty harsh. Prof. Adams is a great lecturer. Would definitely recommend. Downside of the class: Homework assigned 3 times a week. Although it isn't too much.
The curve is harsh. Besides that, he is great.
He was extremely helpful and he seemed to genuinely care about how we did in his class. Would highly recommend

Lucas is by far the nicest professor I have ever had. The pace of this class seemed to work for everyone (but at times could be too slow.) His expectations for learning and testing the material are crystal clear. He is always available, always understanding, always kind, and would bend over backwards for his class. Show up, do the work, receive A.

I was really scared to take Stats 2 because I'm not the best at math, but Professor Lucas really helped me out so much. He replies to emails quickly, is funny and engaging during lecture, and is really sweet and encouraging  couldn't have asked for a better professor! Thanks, Prof. Lucas, for an awesome semester! :)

Professor Lucas is one of the best professors you can get in Statistics. His pace is very easy, as he writes all of the notes on a projected screen, and he explains the material very concisely. He wants his students to pass and puts in plenty of effort to ensure that they understand the material. 1010 would take again!
Super willing - almost desperate - to help. Really sweet guy. Very fair and willing to make revisions according to feedback.

I think that he's over hated, I've taken a lot of different stats professors here and his lectures are pretty average. I think the grading was relatively generous, towards the end he curved better than expected. Overall he's a generally nice dude, and he adequately prepared us for his exams. He definitely deserves better than a 1 imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I love him, lowkey the best professor I've ever had. Very funny, does not know how to record for notes on his ipad. Every thing is TBD, he loves the word TBD. Looks lonely and answers students questions precisely. Was never late and gives great feedbacks for emails, not yet received any email back from him. Seriously, take this guy!!! :)

Genuinely the most non self aware man I have ever met. Does NOT communicate whatsoever, never responds to emails, convoluted lectures and bad curves. inputs grades late every semester. its no coincidence that the class didnt fill. C average by the way

The teaching style didn't work well for me and lecture notes weren't made available. The course structure relied heavily on student responsibility without adequate resources. While I understand professors have different approaches, this particular style made it very difficult to succeed. I would not take another course with this professor.

extremely convoluted lectures and often goes on tangents. He tries to be nice but honestly the curves are brutal, curving exam averages to around a C- which is pretty insane. the final had typos on it. No ed or canvas discussions. Honestly put insane amounts of effort into this class and the effort doesnt match the results for this class.

Lowkey he worst professor I've ever had, I will avoid any class he is teaching. Late, very unorganized, very late and little feedback. Uploads solutions a day/night before midterm. Notes in class are not clear. Often loses notes or they get deleted during class. Super complex and weird grading calculations for final grade.
STAT 150 was empty when this "professor" was teaching it. Now that someone else took it, 150 is full on the first day of enrollment..
When is he leaving back to his institution? Would like to take this course with a competent professor
Terrible professor. I wish I could leave a negative review if I could. But he's absolutely terrible.
Honestly the worst professor I've ever taken, seen, or heard about. Don't know how this guy became a professor let alone graduated college

He is the worst professor I ever encountered. He rambles incoherently, and uploads critical notes hours before exams. Also, he acts annoyed when asked for help and seems unreliable. Avoid at all costs!!!

Guy has no management of the course, 0 awareness of what stuff is graded and the difficulty he sets has extremely high variance. Likes to say that something is "very easy" and then makes mistakes when he does it.
No. No. No. Instantly dropped this professor. Cannot speak coherently, comes in to class late, has no lesson plans just free styles it and speaks in .5X speed. No canvas or course info published.
"Very easy"

he tried to improve later in the course by giving lots of extra credit opportunities. but time management was not very good since we ended up rushing later on and skipping some interesting topics. lack of communication.

Absolutely zero class structure and extremely unorganized. We received our final grades (no final scores!) 1.5 weeks after the deadline. 
Makes several mistakes during class and claims material is "very easy". 
He uploaded the midterm review notes few hours before the exam!
Conducts review session at non-class timings and refuses to record them.
horrible, unclear no communication, very bad
unorganized, unprepared, bad teacher
Really bad. He did not spend time on preparations.

He claims that all of the content is "very easy" and typically blames students when they do not understand the material. He will often say he is too busy to assign work, and when he says he will upload a homework or some form of notes, he will either never do it or he will do it two weeks later.
Avoid at all cost!!!
horrible - unorganized, exams were not related at all to the hw/lectures. worst!!
The feeling of relief and sanity after Gibbs is uncomparable, actually finished slides and speaks like someone who knows what they're talking about
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There is A LOT to memorize but Gomez does well and finishes the slides within one lecture. Lectures are 40-60 slides (much less than Gibbs) and physiology was the easiest of the 3 units. Calm speech that makes me sleepy sometimes, which was unfortunate for 8 AMs. Good slides, but supplement with Youtube!! Many repeat questions from practice finals.

She was not great, oftentimes didn't seem like she knew what she was talking about. Thankfully, the GSIs helped me immensely, but she honestly was not organized with the lectures and it seemed as if it was one of her first times teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was carried by GSIs she sounds like she doesn't know what she's talking about. Sometimes, she even gives the wrong information which makes it even harder to study the already difficult material

Overall just sounded very unsure of herself during lectures, lectures jumped all over the place with no theme to take you through. Sounded confused answering questions. This class was saved by the GSIs, who did a great job with the course material and making it digestible. Content for the entire class is very interesting though.

One of the 3 teachers teaching BIO1A SP'23. Questions on iClicker and on the final were very much expected. Nothing was out of nowhere, which I appreciated from Dr. Gomez. I would say she does speak at a slower pace, so I often would watch her recordings 1.5x speed. Her teaching is really good, straightforward. I liked her section the most.
The easiest section! Her voice is so soothing, and her slides are so easy to understand. She goes over concepts multiple times till you have no choice but to know it. All around great professor
Absolutely enjoyed her class and her lectures were the only thing that kept me interested in Bio 1A.

Dr. Gomez was my favorite out of all of the bio 1a professors. She is so kind and accessible for office hours, and her quiz/test questions are very fair and straight out of the lecture slides for the most part. Her lectures are super clear and interesting. Such a fun portion of the course, I absolutely loved having her as a professor.
Easily the best professor for Spring 2022 of Bio 1A. Very clear and engaging lectures and makes the anatomy section easy to digest. Very fair quizzes and midterm. Highly recommend taking her.

Definitely the best of all the 3 Bio 1A professors. Clear lectures and her quizzes and exams accurately reflect what you are and aren't expected to know. A breath of relief for such a weeder course...

Professor Gomez is amazing! Out of the 3 professors, she was the best and most clear in her lectures. Even though I didn't interact with her personally, it felt like she wanted to see her students succeed. Her exams are very fair and she only asks what she covers in her lectures. Her slides were also very helpful and had emphasis on points to know.

Dr. S is the best! As a student who had never taken chemistry before this class, she made learning enjoyable. She knows when to enlighten students with engaging examples, but also when to refocus on serious work. 10/10 professor, highly recommend!
Amazing lectures, very manageable workload, very responsive on Ed Discussion and very caring about her students.
amazing kind, ukele
Really balanced coursework (credit for HW and participation based on completion), super informational and engaging lectures.
Super engaging lecturer, breaks down topics really well. Dr. Shusterman was always cheerful and attentive, highly recommend taking her class.

Very talented lecturer. She is very good at clarifying concepts and maintains the class in a very organized manner. Will need to attend lecture and crank out practice exams to be successful in this class.
ABSOLUTE GOAT! Looked forward to every lecture. She's a theatre kid so it makes sense.

Dr.Shusterman is an amazing lecturer who is easy to follow. She cares about the success about all of the students, with the class having many resources including tutoring practically all day every day, as well as her also having office hours. The class has online questions that you have to answer during class and easy biweekly homework assignments.
She was great. Super thorough and clear lectures. Easy to follow and gave great study materials.

shes gen rlly nice and she responds to everyones qs rlly well in the ed discussion and is rlly sweet in office hours, explained unit 1 rlly well, however unit 3 was the downfall it was acc so bad she gen oversimplified it and nothing made sense in her lectures + the exam was very dif from prac exams

Although she may have oversimplified a few things, she made gen chem digestible and straightforward. In her class, I was able to maintain an A by simply attending lecture, completing homework, and taking an hour or so each week to review the class topics.

Her enthusiasm during lectures made the topics very easy to comprehend. Although there wasn't a lot of homework to give additional practice, she posted multiple practice exams before the test. Additionally, while attendance isn't exactly mandatory, there is mandatory participation.
Great explainer, go to her office hours.

Friendly and easy to follow lectures! Most people seem to like her more than Dr. N if you take the course with both of them in the Fall, but be aware her test questions seem harder than his.  Really organized class.

Dr. S is a great professor! She is VERY CLEAR about what she teaches (my friend compared her to a kindergarten teacher). Outside of class, you can ask her questions during office hours or on the way to office hours. I love her style of teaching.

I don't say this a lot but she is a great teacher!! Very engaging and explains things well! Can do AKTIV polls from home and watch online lecture recordings instead of going to lecture. Very light hw. Exams are difficult but practice tests are VERY similar. Quizzes only graded on participation. I never went to office hours so idk if they're helpful

Chem 1A was very simple and easy, especially the units she taught. All of the exams have 5+ practice exams and the questions are very true to the actual difficulty of the exams. She has a very lenient grading scale and drops your lowest midterm score in replacement of your final grade.

Dr. S was amazing. She can clearly explain complex chemistry topics in simple terms and analogies, and her office hours were very helpful. Her bubbly personality is uplifting and I am very grateful to have been able to have her as my professor this semester.

She explained everything very clearly and presented information in a way that would help us understand and remember it for tests. Everything was very reasonable and she made the class entertaining. I would definitely recommend her class.
She is a great professor and explains the material very well. The class is pretty tough and fast-paced however.

Dr. S had the most entertaining lectures I've ever attended (she sings and dresses up as Wario). She made sure students scooted to the centre so you could get a seat without stepping over 50 people, which I appreciated. The units she taught were relatively easy, but I do think prior knowledge is required to do well in this class.
Great at teaching Chemistry and is very nice and understanding. Definitely worth attending lecture.

Very very good lectures, and super accessible during office hours! She genuinely wants you to succeed. During her last office hour before the final, she stayed an extra ~1.5 hours to answer questions. Content was hard but she breaks it down very well for us in lecture, which is recorded. My GSI Ry was also amazing! Use Ed Discussion for questions!!

Shusterman taught units 1 and 3 and she was very entertaining and straightforward! The unit exam grades for her exams were also higher than Neuscamman's. For the class, your grade is 76% exams (420 of 550 pts) so def focus on those most, but she does curve your grade at the end of the semester by a few % I think!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. S is a great professor. She explains complicated topics clearly and creates a very supportive environment. Her office hours were extremely helpful, and she was always willing to repeat or rephrase things. Her lectures are visual, well organized, and high energy. However, some of the abstract concepts in Unit 3 could've been emphasized more.
Very great professor her lectures were some of my favorites and her explanations are clear and easy to follow
Simply amazing professor. Lectures were so fun to watch and she explained things so clearly and well!

She is good at explaining concepts and good at explaining, although she did struggle a bit explaining and breaking down Unit 3 (Acids and Bases). She gives good study tips and seems like a caring person. Of course, as with chemistry, some concepts require self-studying even after being explained in lecture. Overall, she is a good professor!
The class is not curved but Professor Shusterman is so passionate about the subject that if you pay attention to her lectures you are bound to do well on the exams for the units she teaches.

Dr. S is a phenomenal professor, and I mean it from the bottom of my heart. She teaches with so much passion, breaks down super difficult concepts in easy-to-understand bites, and really cares for you. Attend office hours and be proactive and you will succeed in this class with no prior chem experience. Just try to take in the spring to avoid Dr N.

Explained things thoroughly and it's clear that she cares for her students and wants them to learn. 3 midterms and a somewhat culminative final were the only things that really counted towards the grade since hw, lecture attendance, and discussion attendance were easy to do. I had no prior experience in chemistry and was able to do well.

I took AP Chem before taking 1A with her and Dr. N, and it made the class very easy. I found Dr. S genuinely incredible in the way she delivered complex material in such an understandable way, and the exams over her units were very fair. Highly recommend taking 1A in the Spring so you don't have to deal with Dr. N

Never took chem before and she made it understandable. Quizzes are technically participation based. Try to take it in the spring because she teaches without Neuscamman (he's much more confusing than she is). Go to all her OH's

Participation: 5%, HW: 9%, Quizzes: 9%, midterms (3) 17% each, Final: 25% (final can replace lowest midterm)
all hail queen shusterman!!

Funny professor who makes the material easy to understand. Explains things intuitively. Her class is pretty chill if you've taken chem in HS, but it's not a cakewalk, so even the strongest students will be slightly challenged. Overall I highly recommend her. Definitely one of the top professors at Cal.

Dr. Shusterman is an amazing professor, she makes the Chem 1A material very digestible and accessible and created a great environment in the class. For the most part, I felt (and heard other students agree) that Dr. S is easier to learn from than Dr. N, so honestly if you can, take the course in the spring with only her, not Fall with both of them.

Alexis was an amazing professor, she was very passionate about what she taught and always showed emotion and passion in her lectures. She was very easy to understand and made material very memorable through demonstrations, hand movements and references. Very passionate professor and made a difficult topic interesting.

Dr. S could make any topic seem simple, her lectures broke things down perfectly and gave a more intuitive understanding of Gen Chem. Her units taught were significantly easier to wrap my head around due to her style of teaching. Also a wonderful resource via office hours, and a genuinely fun person during lectures.

She's a great lecturer and it's very easy to ask questions after class or during office hours. She wants you to succeed and is very sweet, but exams are pretty conceptual. Would recommend taking 1a with her during the spring rather than fall because in the fall she co-instructs with Dr. N
kind professor with good slides :) she is very well educated and provides concise lectures!
she is an amazing professor! expains nicely and makes concepts more approachable. there is a big amount of content to cover though, so exams can be pretty tough. enjoyable class!
Very manageable if you attend lecture
Really good at explaining concepts and genuinely seems to care about students. Responds super fast when you have questions in ed discussion.
Very engaging, with very clear explanations
so hard to do well
LOVED dr.s. clear and informative, easy to understand lectures and genuinely seems like a nice lady.

one of the kindest, clearest, and genuinely caring profs ive ever had. dr. s's teaching quality is so rich, and she explains complex chemistry topics in a very digestible and beginner friendly way. shes super active on ed and will always give detailed and informative replies, i wish she taught higher level chem!!

Professor Shusterman is an excellent lecturer and I would I highly reccommend taking courses with her. I've never met such a caring professor like her. Now keep in mind Chem 1A has 1500 students, so she doesn't really know everyone. During office hours she takes her time learning your name and addresses you by name. She really is amazing.

She is truly one of the best professors I've had while I've been here. Knows how to dumb complicated topics down enough to where its comprehendible and straightforward. Super helpful and accessible outside of class as well.

incredible professor, her lectures are clear, easy to follow, and she breaks down such complex topics into understandable lessons. shes much better than the other professor (Dr. N) and i wish she taught all units. i scored the best on her two exams
Great instructor! Lecture are really enjoyable and understandable. Honestly they tell you how to pass the class. PUSH UPS!!!

She is very kind and understanding. She is a good listening ear and gives incredible feedback. She is a very sweet person. Uses very understandable terms and overall amazing teacher. The class itself is difficult and so is the content. When she teaches its much easier to understand.
Why do birds, suddenly appear, every time, you are near. Just like me, they long to be, close to you.

She was such a great teacher! Gen chem can become difficult if the information gets jumbled, and she did an amazing job of presenting information in an engaging and fun way. She was very approachable and supportive outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She really helps students and wants to help them succeed.

What an absolutely GOATED professor. I have never taken chem before, and Professor Shusterman made the content so simple and so understandable. More professors need to be like Professor Shusterman. One of the best classes I have taken at Berkeley simply because of her. Extremely organized class by the way, and extremely helpful lectures.

Dr. S is genuinely one of the greatest professors I've had. Her lectures are amazing and she truly cares about her students. If you go to class and DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS you're golden. Her grading criteria is also more than fair and she even lowers cutoffs at the end of the semester. You will do well if you put in the effort.

shusterman is an amazing lecturer, she manages to keep all her lectures very engaging and interesting. the topics at the beginning are quite simple but it tends to be a little bit a harder concept-wise towards the end. midterms are pretty similar to the practice ones, just make sure to fully understand those
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's super caring and a great lecturer. You can tell she really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Her lectures are very intuitive and help you build a strong foundation in chemistry. Highly highly recommend!

Dr. S is one of my most favorite professors. She is extremely engaging in class and her slides are easy to follow. I wish she taught all semester and not just half. The exams were pretty difficult in my opinion but they reflect how much studying you put in.

Dr. S is extremely nice and makes lectures worth showing up for. Her interactive lectures and homework was good practice for understanding the concepts. The midterms were much different from homework and were a bit difficult, but there's enough practice exams to do well. My friends who took AP chem did very well, but studying hard will get you far.

Dr. S teaches you chemistry as if you were a child, but not in a condescending manner in a way that's easy to understand and follow. She clearly explains concepts, but always leaves rooms for questions. She makes you think in lecture with her polls and homework is very helpful. Do past exams it's very helpful. You will enjoy this class!!

Super solid professor. Very clear explanations, slides, and super accessible via Ed. Midterms were not particularly difficult either, and final was super easy. Only complaint is that the slides uploaded to Bcourses are not the full versions (which makes sense), but it would be nice to have those somewhere.

Super cool and kind professor! Her lectures were always very understandable, even if it was a hard topic, and she made them super entertaining (with jokes, songs, a little history of chemistry segment at the end of each class, etc). Exams were sometimes tough (as to be expected), but she was a fair grader.

I hadn't taken Chem since 3 years ago, but this class brought me up to speed and well beyond the level of high school. Expectations and grading is very clear and fair, lectures were very worth going to! Lots of demos of experiments, walking through problems, and also singing!

i hated chemistry in high school but this professor made me realize it wasn't the material, it was the teacher! she's so good at explaining topics and so helpful during office hours. she makes herself very accessible and her classes were so interesting. i wish i could take the class again!

This was my first technical course at UC Berkeley and while I didn't appreciate it then (took this class Fall 2023) I do so appreciate Professor Shusterman. She is dedicated and passionate. Her lectures are clear but the course is definitely challenging. There's not much homework so be sure to read up on the content and you'll do very well.
Get ready to sing.

Best professor I've had here at Berkeley. She truly cares about her students and is very approachable with any questions you have. She uses Ed Discussion a lot and she gives you paragraph length explanations. She is truly one of a kind and a great teacher to anyone no matter your background in chemistry. I will miss her.

Dr. Shusterman is an amazing lecturer, and genuinely cares about her students understanding an success. Make sure to keep up and understand the homework problems, but she provides excelent resources for exam prep and is very accessable outside of class hours.
Really nice and knowledgeable professor. Class is tough but if you study be as bad
Taught well but the tests were 10x harder than what we learn in lecture

Dr. S was such a great Chem 1A prof. She was super enthusiastic and clear in her lectures. She sang us songs to help us remember concepts and wore goofy costumes on holidays. She was flexible in her explanations and was always able to pivot if I still wasn't understanding. She was very approachable and her office hours were great!
She is a very engaging lecturer. Sometimes I feel like she treats us like kindergartners but it's fine because she explains concepts really well and makes things easier for us to understand.
such a good lecturer, make everything super clear and was willing to explain everything. made lectures super engaging and make chem actually fun to learn
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I love Dr. S so much. Her lectures were very easy to understand and her office hours were so helpful. She also would make sure to answer everyone's questions on Ed discussion. Her practice exams were exactly like the midterms/final. I definitely recommend taking chem1a with her!!
amazing lecturer, explains chem concepts in a way that makes it easy to understand, seems very sweet and patient, lectures are very engaging, sings great also
Very clear lectures, explained concepts in ways that are easy to understand. Homework and office hours extremely helpful!!

I loved her! I went into Chem 1A with nearly zero chem experience so I was a bit nervous but she made all the content so easy to understand. The class was taught by her and Professor Neuscamman but her teaching style was far better to me. Practice exams are same as midterms and final. One of my favorite professors!

Dr. Shusterman is a wonderful professor! I loved going to lectures, and it was pretty clear that she cared a lot about the subject and her students. Exams were fair, and the practice tests helped a lot. Definitely could have done better in the class, but that was entirely my fault. Very accessible through OH and Ed as well. Recommend!

Excellent lecturer. Explains concepts in an easy to understand and engaging way. She's super helpful outside of class as well and is an all around nice person. As someone who had an awful chemistry teacher in high school and hated chemistry before coming into college, Dr. S. completely changed that.

Dr. S is a talented lecturer + super engaging and kind. She breaks down difficult concepts without oversimplifying, and is accesible on Ed, after class, and during her office hours, which I highly recommend attending. Her passion for teaching and care for students is evident! She also played the ukulele in a few lectures which was entertaining:)

This was such a fun class and I would totally recommend Shusterman as prof!! Really enjoyed chem because of her and she really explained the content well! Just be sure to do the practice exams and you'll be set for the actual exams. Lecture isn't really mandatory but really recommend going!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Compassionate. Understands the different levels that students come into CHEM 1A with. Presents material in a comprehensible manner. I felt more than prepared for almost every midterm that she taught. Glad to have taken this intro chemistry class under her instruction.

Dr. S is my favorite professor at UCB! Make sure to attend OH's and don't be afraid to ask anything you don't understand. She you will work to explain it to you in anyway possible. Dr S wants students to succeed and that's what makes her amazing. Also do practice exams the real ones are similar!

Going into Chem 1A with no prior chemistry knowledge, I was worried about falling behind, but Dr. S explains concepts clearly and truly cares about her students. Shes very responsive on Ed Discussion and took time to learn students names in office hours. The course is challenging, but Dr. S made it worth it. I'd love to take more classes with her!

Dr. S clearly explained and broke down topics in Chem 1A so that literally anyone could understand. I would never get lost in lecture and felt on top of all the material in the class when she was teaching.  Her exams are also very similar to practice exams.  She is quick to respond on Ed with detailed answers and really cares for her students!

Super nice teacher. Very active on EdDiscussion (question answering software). Prioritizes students learning and gives helpful ways of remembering course info. Don't think I've met anyone who dislikes her as a teacher.

Probably the BEST prof ever! I did not like chem going into this class, came out LOVING it!!Not exaggerating when I say she is so talented in making students feel engaged, heard, and just helping them over all.She was on top of the Ed  which is just a platform for us to ask qs outside of class.She also puts effort into knowing names of students:)

Dr. Shusterman such a great teacher. She bring a great energy to class and explains things really well. My favorite part about her was how quick she was to answer my questions on Ed Discussion. She explained everything that I was confused about so well. She was even answering questions on Saturday and Sunday, which was really awesome.

Shusterman does their best to make sure students have a strong understanding of the course topics and cares a lot about not only having the students succeed but also helping students build connections with faculty for possible internships.
She is amazing. She teaches well and at a good pace with animation. Knows how to teach an intro class correctly. Love her so much.

Responds quickly and clearly on Ed, which is awesome. Very upbeat professor who never fails to bring a smile to students' faces and inspires us to become better chemists. Tests are straightforward and are similar to the practices she gives us. Would highly recommend attending lectures and talking to her before/after class.

Dr. S is AMAZING! For the midterms make sure you really study the practice exams she gives you not for memorization but for understanding of the concept. She is super sweet so if you don't understand anything make sure to go to office hours or post on Ed discussion. She makes herself super accessible so take advantage of that.

Shusterman is an amazing professor - her lectures are super engaging and she breaks down even the trickiest concepts. While the exams can be challenging, studying past practice tests and using resources like Unstuckstudy can really help. Definitely take this class if you can!
awsome professor
Exciting and engaging lectures that are easy to understand. Would highly recommend this class.
The goat, easy exams that reflect lecture, very clear lecture in general, and overall good vibes. Would love to take again! 😊
Responds to EdStem rapidly, great lectures, fun professor that seems to care in her students and her subjects. Knows how to engage with students well.

Honestly, the exams were extremely fair and her lectures were super  easy to understand. I only have very limited amount of chem background (took 8th grade chem), and I fumbled on the final exam, but having a clobber as well as 3 midterms helped a lot. I think honestly you don't need to study much, her content is well reflected on the exams well.

She is the most lovely and funny, energetic professor and I'm so glad I got her! She was always explains concepts in fun ways and making sure we get main points. You definitely have to study for tests since lecture covers concepts well, but much of learning calculation requires office hours and tutoring, homework was pretty reasonable.

If you took AP Chem in high school, this class is not very difficult. In fact, we did not have to know the exceptions to rules and I personally felt like I was doing a lot less memorization than in AP Chem. The last unit was the most difficult, but it was still doable. Dr. Shusterman will hold your hand and guide you through Chem 1A.

She is such an amazing professor and so witty in so many way. She does not grade the quizes and if you attend discussion you get full point. However, the exam were pretty difficult but she does provide practice exams, do them and you'll be fine.
Take the practice exams and really study them before midterms/final. The actual exam will be very similar to the practice. Very clear lectures that can be rewatched online.

Shusterman addresses topics in a very simplified way. Readings help if you want a deeper understanding of the topics, but they weren't necessary. Discussions felt boring but were helpful. She releases practice exams from previous semester, which are the most helpful for understanding the material you will see on the exams.

Took this P/NP. I love her teaching style, and she made some of the most confusing ideas digestible for the class. Exams are similar to past exams so study those to understand what she expects of you. No surprises, she makes herself available during office hours and ed stem. HW is through Aktiv, need to buy that, unlimited attempts. Great class!

Brilliant. Generational teaching talent. I had Neuscamman (Neuscamid) for 1A a few weeks last year and the stark difference in teaching ability is staggering. Shusterman WILL make you succeed. She made every topic seamlessly connected. I wish more lower div lecturers were like her. I could've gotten an A but slept in and missed half the final LMAO

I loved taking Chem 1A with Dr. S! Her lectures were really enjoyable and she was easily accessible outside class through Ed Discussion. As long as you understand the concepts, do the homework and go to office hours, you will be good. Make sure to do the practice exams several times if you want to ace the actual exams! :)

Dr. S makes her lectures engaging with tons of songs.  The practice exams are super useful. The class quickly ramps up in difficulty in acid-base chemistry and quantum so be super careful.  Use the textbook, it's more advanced than her lectures but will prepare you, since she sometimes doesn't lecture at the necessary depth.
Great lecturer, extremely helpful, & very compassionate person

Great, updated slides and always showed up enthusiastic. I genuinely enjoyed going to this class. The practice exams were always close to the exams given. Difficult class but definitely possible to get a high grade. Make sure you stay on track as many topics are layered on top of one another. Greatly recommend this professor!
Shusterman is the goat best gen chem professor there is

Had her for 32 and 1A, extremely enthusiastic and talented professor throughout both classes. It's unbelievable how much time and effort she puts into responding to questions on Ed. Highly recommend using Ed Discussion to answer questions, she provides detailed and enthusiastic responses with very short wait times in the days leading up to exams.
Very good teacher for this class.  Actually makes lectures interesting and makes fair exams for students. Overall made Chem 1A not a terrible expereince.
Not too difficult of a class. She does require you to pay for a subscription on an app in order to answer questions in her class.
Awesome! Amazing lecturer.

I thought chemistry was hard and boring before taking her courses, yet she proved me wrong.
She is a great teacher!

Prof Shusterman was a pretty good teacher and would explain concepts well. I did not have a lot of background chem knowledge coming into this class which I think was my downfall. Moves pretty quickly through material. Exams are difficult, but not too crazy

Great professor. Class is not hard unless you skip lectures. She is a very good lecturer and makes the material make sense. Go in person to lectures and you will do well. Tests can be tricky but are very fair and generally are extremely doable if you take good notes and go to lecture.

My fav. class last sem. Never took chem in hs and got an A+. The lectures were fun & easy to follow, especially with pre-lecture preps. Dr. S. and other staff/students replied quickly on Ed discussion, so questions were answered effectively. Tests were completely covered by the lectures, but required flexible application & connection of concepts.

She would just teach and wouldn't assume we know anything. Very nice and had a lot of office hours. We only needed 75% of attendance and homework and quizzes was also at a percent we didn't have to do all of them. She would sing to help us memorize I enjoyed waking up early to go to her class. Class is offered online and on zoom.

Shusterman made classes super engaging and lectures much better then other professors. The class is hard even if you've taken AP Chem. You will learn everything you learned in high school in 3 weeks just a heads up. Tests were difficult but doable if you studies at least a week in advance. Final was not reflective of homework and previous years.

She is really nice, and she tries really hard to make her lectures clear and understandable. She really breaks everything down, and she wants to make sure everyone understands the content. There is a weekly homework assignment. Also a weekly quiz, but you get full credit for just taking it, and they're very helpful. She's very organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: pretty much everyone likes her, and for good reason. she really cares about her students and does everything she can to make sure everyone understands what she's teaching. we cover a lot of content, but it doesn't feel fast because she walks us through everything. genuinely one of the most caring and well-versed professors I've met.
MY CHEMISTRY HERO!!

I came into Chem 1A knowing 0 chemistry. By attending lectures, doing the readings and her practice tests, anyone can succeed. She reuses the format of her exams, responds to ed discussions actively, is open to feedback, is fantastic at breaking down topics into their elementary pieces, and most importantly ensures students are set up for O-Chem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely a super respected professor in the chemistry department, however, often oversimplified A LOT of terms during lecture and later during midterms & finals used more technical terms which was different than what she originally explained in class, hard to calculate own grade based on her algorithm for grades, super kind and warming professor

Great lecturer. The class is hybrid and I attended most lectures via zoom yet the lectures were still incredibly comprehensive. Homework wasn't too difficult and there were always office hours available. There were 3 midterms and a final which was kinda exhausting but with consistent studying and lecture attendance, they're not too bad. Good class.

Dr. Shusterman was by far the best professor I've had so far at Berkeley. Her lectures are very concise and engaging and always incorporate a bit of humor. She is also always willing to offer support outside of class. Overall, she is an excellent professor as long as you make sure to put in your fair share of effort through studying.

She's a good professor and a very good lecturer. Her exams are a bit harder than the practice exams she releases (and she releases a lot of them, so that's helpful). She is responsive to student's needs and I would say her workload isn't too bad either (a homework submission every week + a effort-based graded quiz).

Dr. Shusterman is amazing- I never took a proper Chemistry class in high school, however; as soon I stepped in to this class- I consider General Chemistry as one my favorite classes to take in Cal! Yes, the content can take some time to digest, but working with the GSIs and getting help early on makes a huge difference. Dr. Shusterman is awesome:)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lectures aren't great: they're usually pretty fun, but she consistently skims over topics without going in-depth, leaving explanations half-baked and unclear. The homework doesn't help much either. Textbook provides far more comprehensive, systematic, and useful explanations. Be prepared to do a lot of self-studying to succeed in this class.

Best professor. She is super kind and caring, and has so many office hours. She is so passionate and is very concise in her lectures. She provides multiple practice tests that are similar to exams. She uploads her slides the day before for you to review. And, she made chemistry so fun to learn. I wish I could have her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very enthusiastic and caring, but often tends to oversimplify complicated concepts and fails to do a thorough job of explaining the content. Make sure to spend lots of time doing extra practice on your own outside of attending lectures and doing required homework to do well in this class.

She'll keep you awake in the morning with her interactive lectures though! She tends to oversimplify things during the lectures and uses more technical terms on tests. In retrospect, I wish I studied for the midterms as intense as the final because the questions are pretty fair and not meant to trick you at all.

Best professor I've ever had. Professor Shusterman is so enthusiastic and excited about what she's teaching and her lectures are amazing. Great visuals on her slides and she always has little anecdotes to help us remember concepts. Very accesible and very caring! Don't think twice about taking her for Chem 1A, she's the best.

I LOVED HER CLASS! She explains the concept so well, and everything makes sense when she presents her material. Even though her exams were difficult, it was somewhat doable, and when reviewing the exams with the notes, things clicked. Whatever she taught in lectures was reflected in the exams. I WILL TAKE HER CLASS AGAIN IF I CAN!
Lectures are helpful, tests are fair, easy to get help when you need it w/ lots of resources. Would recommend
Very kind and helpfu

While attendance is not mandatory for your grade, there is are online polls that happen during class that count towards your grade. This class is easy as long as you pay attention. I had no chem background and have done pretty good in the class, just need to take the final. Dr. S has always been able to clarify my questions and provides great help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Shusterman was my best professor in my first semester at Cal, and one of the best teachers I've had in my entire life. She was effortlessly able to make convoluted subjects very digestible. Her exams were a bit tough but fair.

Dr. S was an amazing professor. Her lectures were quite clear and understandable, while also incorporating some real-life examples and humor. Her exams were almost always relevant to the course material, and there are many resources for you if you get stuck and need help.

she is such a sweet lecturer and made me love learning chemistry. her tests were all based on the lectures. she made sure to never include things that she did not discuss during lecture. you should not fall behind though, make sure to go to office hours to ask for help.

SUPER nice/fun professor. Although this class is not an easy A you definitely can get one!! Tests are difficult but there are a lot of resources available. Light HW, no projects, no quizzes. In person or online attendance is mandatory. be ready to pay a mandatory $42 for the "textbook." Overall great class!!

Professor Shusterman is very organized, caring, and clear in her lectures. Attendance is mandatory, but you can participate via Zoom. Class is structured to help you learn - weekly quizzes on completion, check ins throughout class, weekly homework, etc. As someone who didn't take AP Chem, the class was hard, but Shusterman and GSIs were helpful.
She's super engaging and kind. Breaks down difficult concepts and makes them easy to understand. Answers all student questions. Also, having the option to attend lectures over Zoom is super helpful.

Professor Alexis is amazing! She engages the class and makes concepts she's studied for years easy to understand for students. The class is tough itself, but having Professor Alexis is a great way to study Chemistry in Berkeley!
she cool

I am a non-STEM major who took Chem 1A just to fulfill a breadth requirement. Dr. S explains everything very clearly in ways that make sense to everyone, and she just seems like a very kind and caring instructor.

Basically everything on the tests is from lecture which is nice. She is also very fun and engaging during said lectures with demonstrations, real world connections, and songs/jokes. Clearly cares a lot about student success and makes herself available outside of class.
Amazing Lecturer!

Shusterman teaches concisely and her power points are easily understandable. She is entertaining and clearly cares about student success. She is prompt in responding to ed questions and has clear grading criteria with fair labs, lab assignments, and finals. Recommend this class (and chem 1a as well) with her as a professor.

I came to the course with a weak chemistry foundation. Her lectures were very organized and she made a great effort to keep things straightforward while relating concepts to everyday life. They were the highlight of my day. Staying on top of the material, taking practice midterms, and the problem sets prepared me for her (very) fair exams.
Professor Shusterman truly cares about student learning and wants you to succeed in their class!! Engaging and fun lectures & makes Chemistry accessible to everyone :)

Decent professor. Lectures were reasonable, but had to be watched multiple times to really understand the concepts. I recommend building a strong foundation (DO THE PS) and understanding of the concepts right from the beginning or else you'll regret not doing so like I did. Studied two weeks in advance for the final, ended with a B with the curve!

Dr. S is a brilliant professor! As someone who had never taken "real" chemistry before, I thought this class would be incredibly hard, but Dr. S was a very kind and understanding to those like me and her lectures were amazing! The exams were very fair-- as long as you do the practice midterms/finals and go to office hours (or Ed) you will be fine.

One of my favorite professors/teachers I've ever had. She is an amazing woman who not only respects her students, but is easy to work with when dealing with family or other issues that come up. She was very supportive and despite Chem 1A being a difficult class, she makes it understandable and helps you throughout the way. The textbook is online.

I would absolutely recommend taking Chem 1A with Dr. Shusterman! I found myself actually looking forward to her lectures in the mornings. Dr. S is extremely organized and clearly outlines resources available to students. Her grading is very fair and she comes across as approachable and genuinely cares about her students.

Professor Shusterman is very passionate about her work and helping students understand. She is always available on Edstem and is very approachable. Overall her lectures are very organized and she always makes time for people to ask questions. Her homework is reasonable, just requires time management in order to not get overwhelmed.

Dr.S is the best professor I've had so far! Her lectures are very organized and she responds super quickly to any questions on Ed discussion or email. Super approachable and her office hours were very welcoming and insightful. Dr. S also prepares you really well for all the midterms and final. Highly recommend taking chem 1A with Dr. S!!

Professor Shusterman is amazing! One of my favorite professors at Cal! Her lectures are very well organized. She explains difficult concepts very clearly. There are several EC opportunities throughout the semester too! She is very active on Ed discussion and is extremely helpful during office hours. Please please take 1A with her!
Actual GOAT. Makes every lecture entertaining and engaging, if I could have Shusterman for every class I take I would attend every lecture.

Alexis is an awesome lecturer and professor -- she's clear and makes slides that summarize even the most difficult concepts with pictures and concise sentences. Her lectures are engaging and the assignments she gives are good practice. She offers a lot of practice material and is overall very talented at teaching hard ideas in a graspable way.

Homework was to watch lectures, and lectures were full of completing problem sets. VERY easy class, the TAs really carried as they had office hours and would help you individually. I didn't take any chem classes in hs, but after Chem 32 I'm looking forward to Chem 1a with her again!
Super sweet- excited for chem 1A with her in the spring!

I took Chem 1A spring 2022 and I loved Dr. S. It was obvious she cared about her students. Her lectures her engaging. And, she connected the course material to real world concepts at the end of each module so well that I would leave the lecture hall thinking to myself "holy cow, I am learning some cool stuff." Definitely can't go wrong with Dr. S.

Top tier professor. From entertaining demonstrations to clear and concise lectures, Shusterman prepares students well for exams and future classes. Shusterman goes above and beyond, often posting about research opportunities and workshops, and throwing in information about the research going on in Berkeley that relates to lecture concepts.

Amazing teaching style. Her lectures were clear to follow and she loves answering questions, so don't be afraid to approach her! Midterms were a bit difficult but fair overall. Can tell she genuinely cares about her students.

Definitely accessible outside class. Her tests are hard! Walking into each midterm I would feel ready to take them and would just be left feeling confused afterwards. Nonetheless, I love her teaching style and her lectures are engaging and interesting to watch. Attendance is mandatory but you get 10 dropped attendances. Good luck if you take her!

Dr. S. is extremely kind and a great lecturer! CHEM 1A is a hard class but she offers a ton of support. I would recommend going to her OH as they are extremely helpful and stay caught up with lectures and concepts

Professor S was amazing! She explains things very clearly and wants to make sure everyone understands in her class. However I would say this class was difficult but definitely not impossible to pass. I personally could have tried harder. Besides that I would definitely recommend taking chemistry with Dr. S!!

Professor S explains the material very well and is very caring. I could've tried much harder in the course but I learned so much with her. The exams are fair if you keep up with the class. She genuinely made me interested in chemistry even though it isn't remotely similar to my major. The grade bins were also generous! I highly recommend her! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. S is so accessible and offers lots of extra credit! The extra credit opportunities are also fun as well (i.e. a career panel). She responds promptly on Piazza and in great detail. She also is very fair on exams--lots of partial credit and if you are penalized once in a "serial" question, then you won't get penalized twice. Go to office hours!

I was intimidated by Chem 1A but Prof S made the course digestible. She engages you in the material. The quizzes are graded on completion, you get points for iclicker q's, and the exams are fair. As long as you keep up with the lectures and pset's and do the practice exams, you will do just fine :)
Attend office hours!

Dr. Shusterman is great, she is really good at explaining content and is easily accessible with office hours. Chem 1A is a difficult course no matter what, but she makes it doable. She doesn't curve exams and says she MIGHT curve at the end of the semester, which is stressful from not knowing your grade. Otherwise, she's great!

I love Dr. S! I feel utterly inspired by her lectures and demos (which can sometimes be amusingly shocking). She truly cares about her students and gives helpful feedback. There are some confusing moments about the topics but you just gotta work through the PS sets, go to OH, and keep practicing. In the end, everything is extremely rewarding!

I absolutely adore Dr. Shusterman. Her lectures are clear and easy to follow; she's understanding and extremely approachable. This lab class was really fun and engaging; the pre-lab quizzes aren't bad and there were no post labs (you just had to finish a short worksheet by the end of each lab). Highly highly recommend. Final wasn't bad either!
Good and clear lectures, no lab reports!!
Incredible teacher, please take her! P.S. No written lab reports!

Dr. S is the best chemistry professor to take 1A with; she is extremely clear, and lays out material and the steps taken to understand + apply it very skillfully. This class will give you the confidence to take future chem courses and is even fun enough to take as an elective. If you are a chem or biology major/pre-med, TAKE 1A WITH HER.

Dr. S is a really kind professor! CHEM 1A is known for being tough (and this class was tough for sure). However, having Dr. S made everything easier, as she was always caring and available on Piazza. You can really tell she cares about her students! She also took into consideration the pandemic and did adjust grade bins. She's a solid choice!

Although Dr. S is incredibly nice, she is a tough grader. Majority of grade is based on weekly quizzes and 3 midterms. Provided with office hours (very helpful) and review sessions but the questions on exams are very hard. Also given practice exams and study worksheets.

If you get a chance to take Chem 1A with Dr. S, take it! She explains concepts very clearly, is quick to answer questions on Piazza, has clear explanations in office hours, and offers lots of practice material. I recommend going to Team Time (not sure if this was only a COVID thing) and forming a study group to go over all of the practice material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class! Dr. S explained all the concepts in such a clear way. She also was really accessible to all her students, which is really impressive for such a big class. Also, make sure to go to team time if you can, I learned so much there.

Although the course was undoubtedly challenging, Dr. S was extremely considerate and kind, and always went out of her way to help students. Her lectures are solid and there are lots of resources inside the class like study sessions and review worksheets that are very helpful. Dr. S has definitely been one of the best professors I have had thus far!

Chem 32 and Chem 1A online. Dr. S is fair and understanding, always trying to encourage students. She's quick at answering questions on Piazza. The course was moderately challenging for me personally. Pay attention to the lectures, go to office hours and review sessions. Most of the readings just restate what we learn in lecture.

One of the best & passionate teachers I've had! The night before our final, she stayed up until late at night to answer student's questions on Piazza. She is ALWAYS available. Her lectures are clear & interesting. Esp as someone who didn't take AP Chem & only took HS chem freshman year I learned SO much this semester & she's very fair. TAKE HER!!

Dr. S is one of the best chem teachers I've had. With online learning, I think she made the best of a bad situation, she explained the topics clearly, textbook available online for free, and she was just funny, caring, and really wants her students to learn. It's more tedious than it is hard if you've taken a chem class before, but she teaches well
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr.S!!! She is such a kind, fun, and energetic professor. Her lectures are clear and always to the point. If clarification is ever needed, she is very approachable during office hours. The exams are not difficult if you study the material beforehand. Her cheerful attitude was very refreshing during online learning.

Professor Shusterman is a Wonderful chem professor! Her lectures are clear and relatively interesting and she offers a lot fo resources for her students to do well. The exams aren't impossible but you definitely need to study for them! She provides study worksheets, practice exams, and always answers her piazza questions for her students.

LIVE LAUGH LOVE DR.S ! Her lectures are concise and clear, and her office hours are very helpful; she's super receptive to any and all questions. Chemistry is hard and the exams aren't easy (three midterms), but if you watch the lectures and complete all the extra practice sheets/exams she provides, you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. S is such a fantastic professor. Her lab lectures are clear and she doesn't really assume we know anything coming in (ie she goes over all necessary knowledge needed) and her labs are fair and relevant. She also posts office hour recordings which are so so helpful for understanding prelabs and confusing content. Really kind and energetic!

Dr. S is an amazing professor who is hilarious in classes but also extremely good at teaching. She understands that not everyone is coming in with extensive ochem lab skills and she teaches them extremely well. She knows how to teach hard concepts and gets her points across well. Make sure you attend all the lectures and you'll do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. S is a wonderful professor who is hilarious, witty, yet insanely knowledgeable in teaching organic chemistry lab. She understands that people do not come in with extensive ochem lab knowledge & she is great at helping us understand! Even in the online semester I took the course in, she was amazing & truly wanted students to learn! Recommended!
Professor Shusterman is a very understanding and intelligent professor. Her lectures are very clear, and she tries her best to answer all questions and concerns on Piazza.

Pass/No Pass prep class, but this prof's lectures made attendance worth it. I lost all basic Chem knowledge in high school, but retained everything I need to know for my major's Chem requirements. Really sweet and great at answering questions, and is very accessible. Immediately signed up to take her Chem 1A class next semester!

Practically the whole class failed the final this semester. It didn't reflect what we learned in class and it extremely discouraging to students who are just trying to survive the stress of online school, as we navigate the perils of COVID-19. I, like many of my peers, studied so hard for the exam and her class has only made me dislike chemistry

Dr. S is one of the nicest professors I've had at Cal. However, she reads directly from her lecture slides and labs can be very difficult if you didn't come in with a solid understanding of chem 3al. It could've been worse but she was very lenient during covid and was very accessible outside of class.

Prof shusterman is one of the nicest professors I've had while at Berkeley. She completely understands that some students (me included) have very little chem knowledge and is always helpful and patient with our questions. If you're struggling with the material I can't stress enough how helpful her OH are for questions and reviewing concepts
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Alexis is one of the best professors I've encountered at Cal. I have had her for more than one semester, and she has always been available for her students. She is understanding, accessible and has a very fair class. Furthermore, she has always been receptive to student's input and her grading is also very fair and listed in syllabus. Take her

Took Shusterman during spring 2020, her interactive teaching style was the worst. the group was always lost and even after asking GSIs for help in class they would hint that we did it wrong but never clearly explain. the only time I learned something was in her regular styled lectures and the extensive amount of time that I personally put in.

She was a very caring and compassionate professor, but her teaching style was horrific. Interactive chemistry meant having to teach myself the majority of the information, and this only become much worse when everything moved online. I felt the lectures and worksheets were made to seem simplistic, but the tests were much harder and blindsided me.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Alexis was super nice and approachable. She had a great ability to answer questions in a way that was understandable. If I wasn't understanding her answer she was able to change the way she presented it. I know a lot of people did not enjoy the interactive learning style but for someone with little to no chem experience it felt less intimidating.

I took her Chem 1A class P/NP during sp 2020. As someone who hadn't taken chem since HS, this course was difficult. Prof assumed that all students had some chem background, which was false. Her interactive learning format was chaotic and ineffective. She very caring and compassionate, but a novice who does not have an effective teaching style yet.

Although the interactive format was chaotic, I learned from the experience. Dr. S is willing to explain examples and answer questions outside lecture. During the Covid-19 pandemic, she was supportive and flexible. Go to office hrs and ASK QUESTIONS! Her quizzes/tests can be difficult, but it's YOUR responsibility to master the content she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Shusterman is overall a very kind and caring professor. While this class was an easy A for me, I had a hard time learning from her "interactive" teaching style and had to learn a lot of the material on my own. For me, however, her kindness towards students and her flexibility in the onset of the pandemic made me really appreciate her a lot more

I took Dr. S for Chem32 and loved her. So, I decided to take her for Chem1A however she sadly tried to do interactive lectures which explains the native reviews. We also have quizzes every week, a bit difficult. Because of the COVID-19 situation, she has allowed us to redo our second midterm and replaced the final exam with a project.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor S is a very caring and down to earth person. However, her Chem 1a class is the hardest class I have taken at UC Berkeley. Her lectures in no way correlate to quizzes or exams. The interactive format of the class was terrible. I strongly advise against taking Chem 1a with her.

Some of y'all are being way too harsh on her, saying that she didn't help much in light of the covid-19 situation. She let us completely redo the second midterm, making it untimed and letting us receive help from other classmates. She also scrapped the final exam, giving us a project instead which required little to no studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. S really made chemistry fun and teaches complex topics in a very understandable and practical way. Her exams are very fair but you have to really nail down the concepts. I had a horrible chemistry background in high school but ended thoroughly enjoying chemistry after taking this class.

A lot of people have been complaining about the interactive format the first half of the semester. I didnt think it was bad but preferred the lectures, as she is a talented lecturer. Dr. S is genuinely caring and compassionate. Her midterms were very fair and her final project was extremely generous. I always felt like she wanted us to succeed!

Dr. S is the best STEM professor I've had at Berkeley. Her lectures are engaging and though her interactive classes take a while to get used to, I found they really helped me understand the material and make friends in class. Her exams are difficult but fair; she focuses on concepts rather than formulas. Overall, super kind, caring, amazing prof.

Dr. Shusterman is very nice and helpful during office hours. Going into chem1a without previous knowledge will definitely hurt you. Taking chem 32 with her before chem1a truly helped me. Even then, her testing style is quite abstract and unless you mainly teach yourself, you'll fail the midterms. It is doable, just a lot of work.

Prof. Shusterman is a really kind person and is receptive to questions. She's young and lively and definitely knows what she's talking about when it comes to Chemistry. While I am definitely not the best at the subject, I still have no ill will towards her because she's very nice. On all of her Piazza posts and emails, she puts smiley faces :)

Taking Chem 1A with Dr.S was an experience. It was her first time teaching this course and a lot happened due to the virus. If you do not have any chem background, good luck. I studied non-stop for the first midterm just to fail it. She asks questions on material that you are not directly taught, so get ready to put in hours to teach yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I feel like other ppl's assessment of Dr. S is pretty unfair given the COVID situation. She is super accessible and open to help, and in my opinion I do like the INTENT of her interactive lectures, but it needs to be improved with perhaps answer keys for students who still feel lost. Her weekly quizzes are annoying; lots of trick questions asked!

Dr. Shusterman is genuinely very nice and has an enjoyable personality, but the class format and lectures make it incredibly difficult. The interactive lectures teach almost nothing and the class averages on exams have been consistently terrible. Since online lectures became traditional lectures, things have actually gotten easier.

For a class that for students with no AP chem experience, taking AP Chem is a REQUIREMENT to do well in this class. You will learn NOTHING from Shusterman and if you do not already have a solid background in chemistry, good luck because you will fail. Her grading is insanely harsh and her teaching is useless, you will be teaching yourself.

Dr. Shusterman is a wonderful teacher. I disagree with other comments that say that her tests are unfair. Chemistry with her has been extremely enjoyable this year and she provides a human touch to normally sterile STEM classes. One critique would be to give more math-oriented practice problems. But she's is truly a gem and confidence booster.

Dr. Shusterman was a pleasure to learn from. Chemistry in high school was the first subject that had made me feel worthless and stupid. She performed witchcraft and reversed that. Chemistry with her has made me love the subject. She is compassionate, clear, fair and explains things in a way that allows you to understand things fundamentally.

She is a great lecturer, very clear easy to understand. BUT THE MIDTERMS ARE MADE MOSTLY OF MATERIAL THAT IS NOT TAUGHT. I get it, stem classes all require a lot of work, however at least allow it to be things covered in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do NOT take Chem1A with Shusterman if at all possible. You will learn NOTHING, she is horrible at teaching absolutely anything, and you will struggle to pass. Furthermore, her grading is completely unfair (I mean actually unfair, as in she marks you off for things she wont explain and changes criteria for grading after the exam).

Even before the pandemic, Shustermans lesson plans consisted of the students teaching themselves without any guidance. She wants you to discover complex chemistry principles in an hour without offering any help, and then has weekly quizzes testing you on information she doesnt actually teach. Do NOT take this class if you want to learn or pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Shusterman is a hard, uncompassionate teacher who will NEVER postpone, adjust, or curve her midterms, even during a pandemic crisis. Her midterms have a low class average, even when we were allowed to work together, which shows how bad she is at teaching. Her lectures suck, the interactive lessons are useless, and she goes too fast
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have never met a professor who has such little compassion for their students like her. Amid a pandemic crisis, she not only heaps more work on top of you, she disregards all pleas for help, assistance, or understanding and instead grades harder than before, deciding that what makes a sentence is subjective in her class, and she is harsh and mean.

One of the best teachers I have ever met, but there is no perfect teacher. Pro:veryyyyyy considerate, accessible, committed. Want you to gain the most out of this course. Good at explaining concepts. Con:interactive format(not for everyone); class is hard if knowing nothing about chemistry; but you will do great if you really put in hard work

Although I do not love the interactive format, Dr.S has shown that she wants what is best for her students. She does not assign any homework which is nice, but you do have weekly quizzes. She has been really supportive throughout the online school process and is quick to respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Alexis for both Chem 32 and currently for Chem 1A this semester. I have found her to be a very kind, caring and wonderful instructor. She has gone above and beyond to make sure I am successful even at times where I was really struggling like the previous semester. The tests feel fair and she is always very responsive. She's amazing.

These interactive lectures the class is based on are a huge problem. For myself, and for a lot of other students I have talked to, we truly get little to nothing out of this format. Honestly, the only reason why I still go to these lectures is for attendance points. No other class has ever left me so confused about what to study and what to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy
