ngl didnt like her at first but she grew on me. Tests are very hard, but she curves everything generously and offers 4 homework and 4 quiz drops. As long as you study hard, you'll be fine, coming from someone who never took Calc 2 before this class. i personally taught myself a lot of it though bc her lectures a little hard to follow lol.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: A lot of the people complaining are just not used to college, shes a charismatic lecturer and a diva. You can ask her questions after, instead of email. You can also join discussions to ask gsis. Quizzes are easy, curve is generous, the 3 HWs a week really helps when ur behind, I doubt these people ever tried review sessions or discussions lol.

Some of the least useful lectures I've ever attended, despite such heavy emphasis on attendance and lack of course capture. Goes at lightning speed through problems, tells you to “figure it out yourself” for the majority of the work. 36 oftentimes lengthy homework problems each week. Great person, but a horrid teacher.

BE PREPARED FOR THE WORST,  Exam score averages are within the 50's range, a ton of homework assigned per week (1 for every lecture) skims through topics that are essential to the course and you will often have to self study the course. She is also super hard to understand during lecture & no recordings. Syllabus makes it seem lenient, but its not.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever, she goes so fast in lectures that I had to completely self-study. I feel like I came out of lectures more confused than when I went in.

Refrain from taking her. Her lectures aren't helpful. There isn't any time to understand, she often skips steps saying you'll "figure it out." Overall, very difficult to reach. Has an email hierarchy, if you want to request a regrade, she will take points off if she finds it unreasonable. NO COURSE CAPTURE, so you cannot go back to check lectures.

She's by far the worst teacher I've ever had. She goes way too fast in lecture and covers too much content, you pretty much can't ask questions, long homework, bad exam study guides, doesn't go into detail, confusing lecture slides, and very hard exams. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Only redeeming factors: extra credit and a curve

Zvezda is a charismatic professor. Her lectures are very fast-paced, and the notes are very colorful. At first, they were difficult to understand, but towards the end, understanding was very easy. Always pay attention, but CALC 2 IS NOT THAT HARD. Everyone overhyped how difficult it was.

the worst prof I have ever had to deal with in my life. lectures make absolutely 0 sense, like if I had a map I still wouldn't be able to follow her notes. quizzes are super easy. test averages are 50's, so beware. before every lecture id pray i got hit by a car. if u care about your mental health, don't take her class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class covers a bunch of concepts at a rapid pace that makes it difficult for students to process on the lecture slides filled with clutter. Quizzes were manageable, midterms graded unfairly (graded 1000 exams in 5-6 hrs and made asking for regrades risky)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures SUCKED. Class notes don't do anything and basically found myself copying what she wrote down instead of thinking. Weekly quizzes in discussion had the most ridiculous problems that idk how were supposed to be done in 10 min. Midterms were meh but the scale up to 82 is nice. Also is SUPER unaccessible and has some dumb course policies.

Clearly a passionate teacher who brings good energy. Also very fast grader, but that's about all I can say that's positive. Easily the worst lecturer I've ever taken, notes are confusing and impossible to follow even if you are locked in, and then she doesn't even record her lectures. The attendance polls are hard + graded for accuracy.

lectures occasionally overcomplicate subjects and goes extremely quick, but are interesting - she makes lectures fun with her passion for math. exams were fine with practice and there are good resources on canvas.

Alright. She's a professor. Although she's not that good to lecturing. Her pre-written notes are terrible. She just fills them in. That's all lecture is. She doesn't really teach what she's written and she goes at light speed. She funny and sweet, and you can tell she passionate. If you HAVE to take her, just review the lecture, you ain't learning

She is a professor who is not good at lecturing and delivering lectures. The exam will be curved but be careful because it will be 4 times harder than what you practice if this is your 1st time taking Calc2. 
If there is no other choice then take her, as long as you prepare well and are willing to spend at least 6-8 hours a day just for Calc2

Math 52: Lectures are incomprehensible. Treat this class as self study. She spends more time talking about the "Perfect" structure of the course then its content. Exam averages are often bellow 60%. Class is curved to a b- average, so get ready to tank your gpa. If you dont do everything exactly the way she wants your grade will drop. Frustrating.
Was very nice and taught very well. Would recommend to take again

I didn't skip any lecture before I decided to drop this class, she literally makes zero sense in her lectures, overcomplicates the concept in explanation, which makes it entirely a self-study course on top of the difficulty of the content itself (personally for me as someone who is just trying to fulfill the pre req for business). GSI unhelpful.
Tests and Midterms were awful, all self study.

gives 3 times the homework, has bonus points. It is rather concerning the fact that the test comes out 7 hours after the exam, with about 2 - 3 hundred students. Lectures are ok, not the best I've ever had, but certainly not great, and does record the lectures.
Run. Run. Run.
Grades tests without any clear criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: give ridiculous grading criteria.  Worse still, the criteria is confidential. Students have to submit regrade request without any criteria of the exam.
That she is  really super bad at grading. Like even you get the answer the right she will take off majority points
Very quirky. Notes are not helpful. Does not record lecture. Sends a lot of emails. Very long emails. Of course, you cannot email her though
Assigns 30+ hw problems a week and each problem takes a long time. Lectures are super face paced and confusing.
So what can we learn in class? How to fill in a blank slide??? Nothing worth you to stay in the class. Nothing you can learn from this class. How you need to do just learn by yourself.

Yes she is very nice with her grading policy and her grade outlines are very clear, however her lectures suck & very hard to understand. I ended up self teaching myself everything from lecture because her voice and style of lecture become very annoying as what she is saying is not very clear. LOT of homework assignmed in comparison to other profs
She is a fantastic lecturer and has inspired me to pursue mathematics.
so annoying for homework and tests never select again

whoever said the lectures are dora the explorer vibes is absolutely correct. the lectures are fairly engaging but move too fast. they're hard to understand and you're better off watching an organic chemistry tutor video. unless you are naturally good at math, you will definitely struggle more than a bit :(
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she literally gave me "negative" grade on my homework for not copying and pasting her "terms and conditions" rubric
Do not take unless you have to

Stankova is a tough professor. She really cares about her work though so she's a great professor. She makes her lectures interesting and her fill in notes are amazing. Her gsi SUCKED and tells you to drop out. The content is difficult but just practice the math, slowly improve on quizzes and you'll be good. Graded on a curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a tough professor but a good one. Her content is hard but she does really well at teaching it as best as possible. She makes lectures entertaining and encourages participation. Content is difficult but if you keep up with the material and try your best, you can pass. Also grades on a curve.
lectures give dora the explorer vibes, pretty good though

This class was too easy and computational for an upper-division math class. She is tremendously self-conceited and obsessed with her course policies. Her lectures notes are visually appalling to look at and offer absolutely no help. She made us stay after the final and announced the names of every student that got an incomplete, which is illegal.

her lectures are relatively engaging and she gave fill in the blank notes, very passionate about teaching, also has some weird policies about never emailing her. i feel like how well you do is pretty dependent on your gsi as well

Only took her for 110, but I think she is almost a perfect teacher, only held back by her lecture notes being a little fast/cluttered. However, she does a great job at teaching you what matters on a conceptual/visual level and avoiding unnecessary and confusing topics. She also seems like a genuinely good person, and passionate about teaching.

She ensures tests are graded quickly and contrary to some reviews, the partial credit is generous. Her downsides is that she can be quick during lectures and her fill in the blank style is a little too cluttered to understand easily. Would take again simply because of clear grading and course policy, but the hw/tests were too computational.
Very passionate, gives students a lot of materials. Bonus points are really helpful, and she cares about students doing well. Lots of homework but exams are fair with great clobber policy.

the good reviews are from cracked math majors. stankova/gsis weren't the most helpful to struggling students. only cared about enforcing strict course logistics. had snarky ED responses. graded tests in a day so the grading was careless & harsh. your whole grade is dependent on the curve. excessive HW too with no extensions ever unless you're DSP.

Wasn't a fan of her fill-in-the-blank lectures since she would move very fast, but explained concepts very intuitively. Course was unnecessarily computational and not enough emphasis on proofs. Exams were pretty straightforward
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I've had Zvezda for two semesters now and I genuinely enjoyed both classes. I love her fill in the blank notes and she clearly explains concepts. She also makes her office hours very accessible and she is great at clearing up any confusion. Her midterms and finals are also very fair and she is very clear about grading policies.

Brilliant prof, Great lectures, Very easy to understand. Always ask questions, she is very nice and will answer any question. She is funny and charismatic, you will want to go to lectures. It is VERY helpful to take notes on an I-pad for her classes, I HIGHLY recommend it. Or print out copies of her empty notes to fill in during class.
reasonable class and exams

Three problem sets per week, heavily focused on tedious computational work with very little emphasis on conceptual understanding or proofs. The course feels too low level for an upper-division math class.

Stankova is one of my all-time favorite Berkeley professors. She is clearly passionate about math and her students and she does her best to keep lectures light and entertaining. The content is challenging but not impossible and she does her best to explain.
She's not interested in math. I am. Give me enough time, and I will be a better mathematician than her. My regrade request was not frivolous.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: was skeptical in the beginning but considering the difficulty of the content i liked how she made the grading as generous as possible. while i never attended lecture, so i can't speak to that, the homework assignments made it easy to understand all the material. exams were straightforward to what was emphasized in class

A seriously amazing professor. This was my first math class at Berkeley and she made it very easy to succeed. Copious practice, not too much homework, and exams were very fair and felt exactly like the quizzes. Up to 9% extra credit, although most people get somewhat less (I got ~7%). Unparalleled if you like structure, might chafe a bit if not

Prof Stankova is the most organized professor I have taken courses with at Berkeley. You will know what you need to do in the class. Grading is very fast and transparent. She gives lots of materials to help on exams: practice test and document with list of important topics. Organized and enthusiastic! She works hard to make the topics exciting!

Stankova gives the most organized, helpful, systematic class I have ever taken. There are lots of resources for tests, she and GSIs are reachable through Ed, and there are always office hours available. You definitely have to stay on top of it, go to discussions and do HWs. I missed a few lectures but was fine, did a lot of learning with the text.

There is a good amount of homework, but as long as you do them and attend review sessions/discussions from GSI's, you would do well in this class. Prof Stankova cares a lot about her students and is very passionate. Sometimes she does go fast during lecture, so attending discussions can be helpful. But overall, best math professor I've had so far.

Surprised I got an A. Her lecture style is horrible, stupid fill in blank notes. Lots of resources to prepare for exams though so do that. Don't worry if you miss a lecture or two (i missed a week and it wasn't that bad). Lots of bonus extra credit. Generous syllabus policy. Hate it out strict she is with communication. LOTS of HW but helps prep.

Initially, I thought the professor was tough, and she was so fast-paced during the lecture that I could merely keep up with her. Polls are hard; the concepts and her lectures are quite confusing. But after the temper of midterms, I studied more, and thanks to Zvezda's friendly encouragement and relatively straightforward exam, I finally did better.

The exams are worth most of your grade but the quizzes are also important for a decent grade. Although the lectures aren't necessary, and many consider unhelpful, if you want to succeed in this class I highly recommend going to as many as possible and seriously paying attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Stankova is a pretty fun and energetic lecturer, although she is very fast-paced with her fill-in-the-blank notes that force you to learn a lot of the material on your own time. Plenty of resources to get help in the class if needed. Lots of homework and weekly quizzes, but if you just stay on top of it, you should be able to pass the class!

Stankova is extremely passionate and caring as a teacher. Take advantage of all of your resources with her - attend her office hours (she doesn't make you feel stupid for asking even the most simple questions), ask questions in Ed Discussion (she often replies within 30 minutes), and take advantage of the extra credit opportunities!

Stankova is very knowledgeable about the subject, but the way she formats her lectures made it difficult for me. I felt that she went too fast many times, and I would often get lost.  As a result, I mainly learned from the textbook and online videos.  Fortunately, her exams were fairly straightforward and doable if you put effort into the class.

poor lectures (fill-in-the-blank style lectures that are not engaging). loves to engage in gimmicks that make the class seem harder than it is. too much arithmetic on exams (need to simplify answers). course policies are too complicated and sends too many announcements that are each too long. restricts access to materials for no good reason.
Hell no. Do. Not. Take. Unless u can do very well in math. This class humbles you. Don't get cooked.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Tough, but fair. Taking advantage of the provided resources will basically guarantee success.

Does not want to screw her students over and will overwrite syllabus policies that have a detrimental effect on students.

Offers tons of extra credit in lectures, on tests, and surveys.

Great, passionate lecturer

Prof Stankova's lectures and class overall were very organized. Exams were reasonable, office hours were helpful. Textbook was helpful too, but her lecture notes are straightforward enough to follow along. Good communication and very timely grading. I would definitely take her class again.

Please don't listen to all the complaints about the rescaling fiasco! Professor Stankova fixed the situation the next day by rescaling our quizzes in a much fairer way, and was open with us about why we have strict course policies. She is a fair, passionate, and caring professor, and all you need to do is put in your fair share of work.

do not take this professor. we all found out at the end of dead week that our quiz grades would be curved down (rescaled). students had a quiz literally every week and some worked to get an A quiz average but the rescale curved an A down to a C.  This was done in the name of "fairness" but is VERY unfair and will negatively impact people's grades.

Don't take her class! She curves down your quiz grade!!! The curving policy is totally hilarious. She cares about too many unnecessary policies, and I feel like it's more helpful to read the text book than taking her class. The midterms are very short, only 3 FRQ and 5 T/F, thus a minor mistake can lead to a very low score. :(
Worsts Proffesor in the world!!! Seriously, she was terrible. She curved down our grades!!! Don't take any class with her - you're gonna suffer!!!!!

Great Professor overall, keeps the class very engaged. There are a few times were I had no clue what was going on, but through the HW and the quizzes, it made sense eventually. She provides online notes, practice midterms/finals, review handouts at discussions. Make sure to attend lectures because its easy to fall behind.
Not accommodating at all, cares so much about policies and makes it so difficult to manage class with so many units.

Stankova is a very cracked professor with many impressive accomplishments in her academic discipline. Her grading policies are incredibly generous compared to most other professors at Cal as there's a decent amount of quiz drops and all exams are curved to a median of 82%. Generally speaking a very nice person with the occasional humor as well.

She has a lot of free extra credit that does add up, her first 2 midterms were pretty straightforward and they are all curved to a median of 82%. Fair policies. Lectures can go fast but pairing that with the textbook and the discussion sections the material is very doable. I also had great GSI (Wanzhou) so that def helped in enjoying and learning.

I absolutely love Zvezda. Her teaching style in thorough and engaging. She made topics interesting and had an excellent blend of mixing proofs and worked examples within lecture. She is clear in grading and gives projected final grades after every midterm. I am taking another class with her in the Spring and feel so lucky to be taught by her.

I love Stankova's lectures so much! They are fast at times - I usually finish my notes after lecture. I am a horrible test-taker, despite studying for multiple days before an exam, which explains why I got a low grade. The homework is a bit extensive but you need the practice in order to really understand the concepts. DO THE BONUS!!!

Like any other class, just staying on top of the material will get you through this class. There is no need to use her notes unless you go to lecture and follow along. I found the textbook to teach me everything I needed to know. It's a pretty basic topic to understand from just the textbook. She is strict about her rules and regulations.

Stankova is a great lecturer and her course guidelines are veryyyyy lenient + there are extra credit polls in every lecture. Some of the negative reviews I saw here are cause of how strict she is, but given how lenient she is I think her strictness is warranted.

She is very good at breaking down the material. Unfortunately I didn't go to many lectures and was behind. When I watched the lectures and caught up, I was very well prepared for the final and midterms. Just go to the quizzes and watch the lectures and you're good.
has a set of horrible longs rules about what is "appropriate" for edstem and a horribly long syllabus and hates it when students email her or gsi. her lectures are horrible too
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Profesor Zvezda teaches an engaging but demanding math class. Attending lectures is a must, and the syllabus must be closely followed. However, there are plenty of opportunities for extra credit to help boost your grade. I found UnstuckStudy AI to be a valuable study tool alongside the textbook.

shes not horrible but she's not good either. previewed all the materials before class and did practice problems, yet her lectures still somehow made everything more confusing and complicated. very smart and accomplished but can't teach at all.
edit: changed to 1 star cuz what was that last lecture

Best math professor I had at Cal! I took Math 1B and 54 with her. Homework and discussion problems are a lot like the exams and her review sessions are super helpful. Provides many resources to help you succeed and provides extremely legible and fun notes. She gets exams graded quickly and is overall a great professor.

She makes it impossible to reach out to her or any of the GSIs by not allowing anyone email the staff. She cares more about the students following her unnecessary policies rather than making sure they are learning. Frequently goes overtime in lecture and doesn't allow  students to leave and gets mad when they do.

Stankova was the best math professor I've ever had. Yes, the class content itself was hard, but her lectures were awesome. She has SUCH clear policies and grading criteria and that was so helpful for me. Any question you could possibly have about her class she had already outlined in the syllabus, and there were lots of extra credit opportunities.

Extremely rude and condescending towards students. Basically if the question is answered on the syllabus, she will clown on you for not reading it but the syllabus is 15 pages long! She also has a really strict set of rules on edstem and she will ban you if you violate the policies more than once. No other class is like this with ed, only her.
mean, inconsiderate of students, extremely authoritative. bad experience and the semester just started.
Stankova is an excellent lecturer and a very funny and interesting personality in office hours. I think she did a great job with this course and would recommend MATH 74 to anyone interested in math.

Her class is well organized and gives a really clear grading and curving formula at the start of the class. She fills in blanks on her iPad during lectures, which I didn't really like. There are extra credit opportunities during lecture and on exams. Exams are pretty easy compared to others, and she gives practice exams. Has a Clobber policy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She goes through the steps of different problems and she was also super nice. I like how forgiving her policy for midterms was. Her class was super difficult though and she is mean about being emailed.

She is ok lecturer with IPad, and a great lecturer with the chalkboard. Her pages are very organized, and I was lucky to have the best GSI. Only bad thing is she does not allow you to send emails to both her and her GSIs. But essentially, she has lots of OH, which makes it okay.
I hated my life because of her i swear to god the worst professor i have ever met
Bad experience. Avoid.

Zvezda is very energetic and passionate which makes it bearable to sit through lectures although they are fast paced. Quizzes every Friday which could be tough sometimes. Exams worth 75% of the grade but generous grading rubrics. TONS of extra credit so she makes it very easy to succeed in her class. Put in the effort and you will get a good grade.

Zvezda's a really cracked professor - she's respected in her field and it shows in her teaching. However, she is very strict, and although there is merit in teaching that way, I was disappointed in her stubbornness. One day, she was upset and decided to not project the blackboard anymore, which hurt the ability of visually disabled people to learn.
Many opportunities for extra credit and lectures were wonderful and engaging. Read the syllabus carefully.

Awesome professor with entertaining lectures - you even get to learn a bit of yoga and listen to music! Would highly recommend attending all lectures and sections. Lots of opportunities for extra credit and grade drops for homework, quizzes, along with a clobber for both midterms.

Stankova is a fairly engaging lecturer I'd say but she can be very strict. MAKE SURE to read the syllabus carefully. She is not flexible in regards to the syllabus and will not stray away from it, so make sure you read it in fine print!

Zvezda is a decent lecturer and she is a funny person. However, she is very strict and terse when responding to questions, especially on Edstem. Instead of answering, she will often tell you to simply "look at lecture notes and slides" instead of answering the question, often adding a remark that "we've covered this before." Very authoritative.
Mean, inconsiderate, not flexible, worst experience i had taking math class in berkeley.

The class policies were generous! Extra credit, clobber w/ 2 mts, and 4 quiz drops. However, I didn't really like lecture. Didn't learn much. The notes were fill in the blank, and if you don't have an iPad it's so hard to write everything down. Zvezda might seem picky at first, but if you talk with her in OH, she's actually really nice and cool :)
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I genuinely loved Professor Stankova -- I found her to be such a funny and energetic person, and that made lectures so much more interesting. Lecture definitely moves fast, but you adjust to the pace. The homeworks really emphasize the material and are great practice for exams, which were never a surprise in terms of content/types of questions.

horrible teacher, expects students to write more than what is physically possible to write in 1 hour (because she doesn't even write everything). Midterm grading is harsh and runs class extremely authoritatively.

She excels as a lecturer, but her notes are challenging without prior textbook review. Read chapters beforehand, review notes, and complete homework promptly. Expect inflexibility with exams, especially if conflicts with other classes. Exam date changes are unlikely to change.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There was a lot of practice in this course, which was good preparation for exams. The exams are fair, with a difficulty similar to problems from the homework. The course is very fast-paced, but the lectures are very good only if you can catch up with the material. The exam reviews are useful. The difficulty of the quizzes varies by section greatly.

People hate her for being tough, but she cares a lot and the math taught by her WILL STICK in your head for a long time. Zvezda is much easier and very kind to talk to during OH and she takes it personally that you learn well although she may pretend the other way. She is a hilarious lecturer and definitely one of my favorites!

Svezda's lectures are incredibly informative and entertaining, but their fast pace as a result of being done with a "fill-in" note style makes it difficult to keep up sometimes. If you stay on top of the homework it is very manageable, and it prepares you very well for exams. Zvezda is hilarious and clearly cares about her students.

Great professor, had her Math 1B. For Math 54 she didn't follow the textbook that much for the Diff-Eq's portion. She is somewhat of a tough grader on tests, but not completely unreasonable. Recursive Final Exam is great, lectures are fun. Only real complaint is the amount of homework she assigned, it's 3 per week and like 10-12 problems each.

Zvezda is an amazing professor. I struggled a lot at the beginning of the semester as this was my first math course at Berkeley, but there are so many resources. The homework prepares you for the quizzes and exams so actually do it. GSI office hours were a lifesaver for me. Exams are very fair and there is clobber, along with up to 9% of EC.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Zvesda rly cares about her students. Her lecture notes are super detailed and sm effort in her emails/announcements. Great extra credit opportunities!! GSIs also grade the midterm/final the day you take it!? Quizzes aren't bad, exam content is relatively similar to homework/quizzes if you study. I like her as a prof but lectures can get confusing.
Wonderful professor, 10/10 would take again. Very clear grading criteria and what each grade is percentage wise. Lectures are fun and well structured, and gives very very generous exams.

Not my favorite instructor but she was okay. Very organized with her lecture content and provided a lot of resources before exams. Hardest part was getting used to her way of testing, the multiple choice through me off a bit but I slowly improved throughout the semester. Taking the hw seriously is very necessary.

Really knowledgeable and engaging lecturer, her lectures are really funny! There are lots of opportunities for extra credit in the class, so be sure to show up to lecture and participate in the polls. Her class is very well organized and clear in how it is organized. Clobber policy is generous, but beware that the final is difficult!

Zvezda is the best. She is a super cool person and very knowledgable. It was a privilege to be taught by her. Her lectures are engaging and helpful. She sets really clear grading criteria and had up to 9% extra credit available through lecture polls, bonus questions, and mid-semester surveys.

Lectures were comprehensive and class-specific materiels, while restricted-viewing, were plentiful. Homework was higher than average.
Quizzes and exams were homework difficulty, perfectly doable without out-of-course resources or even reading the textbook.
Course policies felt arbitrary at times and were strictly enforced, but were clearly stated.

She is a smart person and engaging lecturer, but arrogant and unreasonable. She happily swung the ban-hammer numerous times on EdStem for little reason. She does not allow enough time for tests nor quizzes and makes fun of students during lecture. I have never been in a course with more insane policies. Intentionally plants typos in review sheets.

9% extra credit and a clobber policy to override two midterms. Lecture notes are detailed and well-written but hard to interpret. She is very enthusiastic about teaching but each lecture is very fast and hard to understand. Get used to the pace of her lectures very late in the semester. The exams are easier than the homework and quizes.

Her lectures were too fast and complicated to understand leading me to depend on youtubers for understanding of concepts taught in class. However, she gives a lot of EC. She also prepares you with hard midterms in the lead up for a relatively moderate final that can clobber the midterm scores. Make sure to go to discussion and seek OH help.

I hated her until the end of the semester - her lectures made no sense, I learned most materials omo, and there was just so much homework (based on completion but I did them with care to learn). However, I talked to her in person and she turned out to be the nicest person I've ever met, so if you're taking her - talk to her during OH, it helps!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My experience with Zvesda in Math 54 this semester was fantastic. Her lectures give me a great understanding of the material while also being funny and entertaining. This class singlehandedly inspired me to consider majoring in Mathematics. Can't wait to take another class with her in the future.
lots of homework but easy exams

Professor Stankova's course was well-organized and fair. There were plenty of resources to succeed (office hours+discussion sections), and I found her grading to be more than fair (the final, which can clobber both midterms, was not too hard!) There was up to 8% extra credit available and her midterm+final reviews were so helpful! I
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
I found her lecture style to be overly complicated & personally wasnt a big fan of her iPad notes. Toward the start of the course, I'd watch other lecturers' videos of Math 54 and read the textbook in depth to understand course material.

However, exams felt super fair and straightfoward; you should be fine if you understand the homework & quizzes.

She is very bad at giving material to make the class easier to study for. Here homeworks are beyond the scope of the midterms. I hate when she writes on the chalkboard when literally no one can read it.

This class was a terrible experience. Her lectures were awful she explains the concepts in such a confusing way that you have to learn the course on youtube. You could put a piece of plywood in Dwinelle hall for an hour every MWF and learn the same amount of content. Also none of her supplemental materials are available online wtf.
The content is hard but she puts in a lot of effort into providing resources, and she is very enthusiastic about teaching. Zvezda is mother.

I genuinely love Zvezda. I personally enjoy her lectures and guided notes and as long as you attend every lecture and pay attention you will be on track. The tests are not difficult and very similar to homework problems and the practice tests. If you spend a decent amount of time on the material doing homework and understand it you're good.

She will not care if you are sick or if your family member passed away. An acceptable grade is only possible spending hours each week using youtube from other lecturers to supplement lecturers which involve using as much complicated math terms as possible. Horrendous teaching and grade policy. Class is excessively unacomidating, unclear, and hard.

Zvezda is an icon! If you attend / fill out the notes during lectures, complete hw (to the best of your ability), and attend section, then the midterms/final were not too bad. She was an interesting lecturer, and I always found myself engaged.
bmc
Her teaching style is so difficult. She speeds through concepts and I never felt like I actually learned anything.
Her lectures and notes are very good! You can also get a little extra credit from in class polls.
the worst professor I have even met. uncooperative,

Stankova was a great professor, interesting lectures, and quite funny to keep you awake in the morning. She knows what she is talking about. If you are willing to put in the effort, her class will be easy.

Her lectures were very clear as there was fill-in-blank notes given before class. There were quizzes every week but they weren't too bad. However, sometimes the homework gets VERY difficult to complete. Syllabus was very clear and that if you are struggling even a little bit in the class, GET HELP or else your grade in the class will slip.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dont take her if you do not have to

Lots of people don't like herteaching style, but I think it's fine. Her lectures are fast bc she is passionate about math and wants to teach it. Her tests are not hard if you do the homework and pull your weight. Tough class bc there's lots of homework, but I learned the most I've ever learned in a math class. She also gives ec if you go to lecture

Good luck if you're taking this class with her... I have to take math 54 next sem but am not going to take it because she is teaching it. Her lectures seem to include so much yet you actually don't learn anything because she cant explain things lol. avoid.

Lectures very hard to follow along. I took Calc BC before which helped me a lot. Lots of homework. Got lucky with my GSI for section so I learned there. Class has a resurrection final but I wouldn't rely on that bc it was VERY hard. Rely on your midterm grades, which were easier exams. Class is VERY curved though so many people get A's and B's.

I wish I could like this class but I felt like I learned more math from Organic Chemistry Tutor than how this class is taught. Although Stankova has an engaging personality I don't retain anything from her lectures--they're fill in the blank notes and she goes way too fast. Exams were fair which made me pass but didn't learn ish from lecture style

Professor Stankova goes above and beyond for the class, providing lecture notes, recordings, and many past exams. Our midterms were released within the day, and final released a day later. Very respectable professor! The course moves fast, but she keeps the course enjoyable and extremely fair.

Enthusiastic and passionate professor but exams were difficult and there was not good preparation for the exams. Threatened to take away lecture notes and class recordings claiming that prior to Covid she didn't so giving them now is very generous. The class is fast paced and hard to follow along in lecture.

I HATE her notes, I cannot keep track of them. There are too many smiley faces and colors, it's very messy. She goes through examples VERY fast - she tends to assume that the students already know the content so she flies through it. Because of this I didn't pay attention in lecture. The only thing I learned from was the textbook.
Horrible. Horrible person, no regard for unique circumstances, no support. Mean grader, no exceptions whatsoever.

Zvezda is energetic, knowledgeable, and passionate about math. 1B is the first math class that many freshmen struggle with, and thus problems stemming from poor/outdated study habits may be falsely attributed to her teaching style. No one is perfect and there were inconveniences in this class, but there are more than enough resources to succeed.
You will have lots of homework. In fact you may think it is too much and it is. Yet, she is an amazing lecturer with even clearer lecture notes that she gives to you for the rest of the semester.

I loved the music she played at the start of class. She was also really quick in exam turn around, taking a day to grade the finals. She always went the extra mile for student learning like crafting great lecture notes, posting lecture recordings, and giving a lot of partial credit on exam short answer questions for writing out your steps.

She is one of the worst professors ever. I had so much patience with her, but if you are failing, there is no help from her or her GSI's. She hates when students email her, so you can't email her. She says refer to the syllabus but the syllabus is specific to everything she wants. Guessing in exams is not allowed because you will not get credit.

Prof. Zvezda's leadership style and personality makes herself a double edged sword. On the one hand, her lecture is inspirational, and she maintains a good work ethic all the time. On the other hand, her policies are strict and don't provide adequate amount of resources for students to review and study after the lecture. Also, a bit stubborn.

During the first half of the semester, I very much disliked the way Ms. Stankova taught her lectures. But her quirky style of teaching started to grow on me to the point now where I am very excited to take Math 54 with her next semester. Her class is rigorous and her exams are difficult, but you will learn a lot as her brilliance is infectious.

She has her own particular way of teaching during lectures that might help visual learners and others. However, for me, they were complicated to understand and I would have preferred if she worked out the problem with us instead of presenting how to do it and rushing through it. She is also very difficult to reach since she has an "email hierarchy"

Rather unpopular opinion, but I thought Zvezda was alright. I thought the fillable lecture notes were nice, and contrary to others, I thought prep materials were adequate. Yes, she does have some eccentricities/ego & does gloss over some things in lecture, but to overcome these, GO TO GSI OH's FREQUENTLY, it will help MASSIVELY. GSI's are the key.

On the final, I received a 0/20 on a question that I got correct.  The grader deducted full points because I used an alternate method of solving the problem.  I have to take math class next semester for my major, and I am electing to take the more difficult math class just to avoid having her for a second semester.  plenty of review materials tho

Zvezda is passionate about math but WAY too much hw, too high of expectations for how much time devoted to class, notes are difficult to decipher bc lack of structure. I had a good GSI who was super helpful but I learned the material independently besides that. good things: ton of review materials, course captures uploaded, final clobber policy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Stankova is a very proficient lecturer with great notes to follow. She always expresses enthusiasm and tests are fair. On the negative side, rules about regrades/emails/questions are strict. + in general, calculus is difficult. A great feature is the fact that lectures are uploaded and extra credit is available by polls in class.

Great class if you want to learn Math 54 materials. Good at first, but slowly the class got more centered around her than the students. O chem tutor replaced lectures for me. Threatened to withhold lecture videos, and ACTUALLY withheld FINAL REVIEW MATERIAL, we had no access to solutions of past exams and thus couldn't learn from their structure.
She does not care about her students. She does not offer clear communication or options at all.

There are professors who get a bad rep b/c they dont seem to care about teaching.
Stankova's different.Although she does seem to care about teaching,she gatekeeps material to prevent students from learning the best they can.What she should've done is to allow students learn the material that best fits them,instead of dictating how they should learn

Her style of teaching is just having you fill in the blanks instead of take down what you need. She tries to be interactive with the class which could be nice sometimes but I think that method works better in a high school class of a smaller size. Overall, hard to keep up the lecture because she doesn't give you too much time to take down notes.

This class was just not a great environment to be in. A lot of the time she made it hard to reach out to her because she doesn't allow students to send her emails directly. Her tests randomly changed the way they were structured. Overall one of my most stressful classes at Berkeley.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: huge ego. unbearable. makes class harder than it already is. do not take her, for your own sanity.

Prof. Stankova is not an ideal lecturer. As many others noted, her ego affects her teaching. She delayed material due to "unsatisfactory attendance." Homework assignments are also VERY heavy; with roughly 36-40 questions a week. Her expectations are strict and expect to get an earful if you ask something that was "answered" on the 15-page syllabus.

I think her class was challenging but manageable. This is coming from someone who had a weak foundation in Calculus and taking 2 other technicals. Workload is one assignment per lecture. Midterms are fairly short but still challenging enough and easy to pass if you study by looking at her past exams. It's an intermediate class which requires time.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: maybe she is great in her field, but not a good lecturer. her grading and requirements for class are devastating.

While Stankova is undeniably brilliant, I personally found her lectures and notes very hard to follow and used Organic Chemistry Tutor to understand the course content instead. She also delayed important class material because students weren't showing up to her 9 AM lecture. Otherwise, the course content is manageable despite a heavy homework load.

Prof. Stankova is easily one of the smartest professors I've had at Cal; when it comes to her ability to teach, she is phenomenal, and the course is quite reasonable (despite a large homework load). However, the professor has a massive ego that often got in the way of her teaching, especially when she threatened to withhold course materials.

There's no denying that she's smart, but because of that she brushes over crucial steps when solving problems during lecture because such things come intuitively to her. She also uses many cryptic terminologies, making it hard to follow the content she is teaching. I don't gain much from lecture because her notes are difficult to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Stankova is intelligent, and her passion for math is definitely seen through her fast-paced lectures. The class is difficult and she gives a lot of homework (for each lecture!) so be prepared. However, the homework pushes you to understand the concepts deeper, and her tests are not difficult. She also curves generously.

The most unbearable professor I have ever experienced. Her ego is through the roof but so fragile that people not showing up to her 9 a.m. lecture hurt her feelings to the point she delays necessary class material. Quizzes are much harder than homework & midterms. There is a quiz every week, only 10 minutes long. The homework load: HEAVY AF!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: at this point in the semester I don't go to lecture and use Ochem tutor to supplement. I feel like I learn much more this way. I find her lectures spend way more time on proofs than harder questions that we would benefit from knowing how to do on hws, quizzes, and exams. overall mid experience. not terrible, but annoying class. use her notes tho.

From the pov of someone who is not privileged, I can easliy say this is FAIR. Alot of people did not like her old school style of note taking or the homeworks from the textbook, but i HIGHLY appreciated it. It helped me understand math1b so much better and it reminded me to take my time on it. (if your planning on cheating, definitely dont take it)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof. Star is a 7/5 professor. Her lectures are very rich. While her unbearable logistics make the learning experience scores 2/5. She cares about students but sometimes I feel she may focus too much on stellar students and students who 'follow the instructions'. Everyone could get trained to be a star.

Prof Stankova is absolutely an amazing lecturer with a lot of passion. Her lectures are engaging and she definitely knows how to engage students. Be ready to do your homework. IMO the best way to study for her exams is re-doing quizzes and section materials.

Took this class in spring. Tons of HW but it's only a small percentage of the grade. Exams aren't that hard but you will not get much partial credit. Clobber saved my grade so use it well. Lectures are amazing and Zvezda is very skilled at that kind of teaching.

Very strict professor. It's her way or the highway. She made Lin alg very accessible while still retaining the mathematical integrity. I would have preferred more proofs and advanced material. Less focus on Jordan Canonical Form more on PCA/SVD which we never covered. A genius in her own right. I didn't like her one bit.

Prof Stankova is exceptionally uninspiring. I have more to say of Prof Stankova than can fit in 350 characters but here are the main points, 
Good
- Lots of study materials and well thought out lectures
Bad
- Very rigid
-Unprofessional; ridicules students over canvas quoting private comments
- Unclear criteria
Math 53 will be awful with this prof.
Zvezda is a great lecturer. She sends about 10 quadrillion emails per day so be aware of that. Her exams aren't awful but they're easy to mess up if you fall behind in the class.

horrible professor. the professor is unreachable and so are the GSIs. attendance is mandatory. so much homework, and only worth 5% of your grade.  very fast paced and her lecture notes are the most confusing ever. strictly goes by her syllabus and is not understanding at all even in the midst of a pandemic. would not recommend.

I have never had such an unaccommodating professor. Lives by her syllabus and there is no leniency even for exigent circumstances. She discourages you from reaching out to her via email and she is just a very hard professor to reach out to. Her lectures move way too fast and her elaborate notes are really hard to follow. I don't recommend.

Stankova is a math genius but a poor professor.  This class will take a lot of time.  You may pass, but you will not enjoy it and the setup is horrible. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

Professor Stankova might be very into what she is teaching, but she is a very strict and unaccomodating professor who cares little about what problems a student might have that would make their learning inefficient. she knows the material well but arbitrary course policies make this course needlessly difficult. judging from piazza posts a lot of other students feel this way but she intimidates anyone who voices complaints and often tries to deflect responsibility.
